packageRules.description: tsdown and @tsdown/css are released in lockstep and must be updated together
Action version and digest bumps are low-risk; majors are still held back by the rule below
next 16.3.1 ships a broken `output: standalone` bundle under pnpm (@swc/helpers esm/ is not traced); fixed in canary, so allow 16.3.2+
TypeScript 7 has no stable compiler API yet (tsdown) and is outside typedoc's peer range
DuckDB 2 may change the on-disk format of stored OCELs and r4pm imports, and would force library users onto 2.x; bump deliberately after testing
Backend Python is part of the plugin contract: plugin wheels are built per CPython version (e.g. cp313), so bump it deliberately. Digest updates within 3.13 are still allowed
Keep the uv builder image on the same Python as the runtime image
